For our client, The Kraft Heinz Company , we are looking for a Global Nutrition Consultant . Profile As Global Nutrition Consultant, you will play a key role in advancing the Global Nutrition Team's 3-year roadmap to accelerate portfolio transformation. Your focus will be on reviewing and updating the Global Nutrition Targets (GNTs) across product categories. 
You develop and execute detailed work plans to review current GNTs, including establishing clear deliverable milestones and timelines. You assess category classifications, names, descriptions, and product examples to identify gaps and opportunities for clearer categorization. You evaluate beverage criteria, total sugar thresholds, and the impact of naturally occurring sugars, and you identify opportunities to align targets with external policy and regulatory developments such as nutrient profile models and voluntary sodium targets. Throughout the project, you collaborate closely with nutritionists across zones and relevant internal stakeholders. 
 Who we're looking for You hold an MSc in Nutrition Science or a related field and bring 1-2 years of experience in nutrition science, preferably within the food industry. You are comfortable working cross-functionally and coordinating global projects, and you communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Strong analytical, organizational, and time management skills - Excellent written and spoken English - Experience with global project coordination and stakeholder management Department The Global Nutrition Team is responsible for driving portfolio transformation through science-based nutrition strategies.
